item.name: Bandage
item.cardSummary: Bandage is the steady recovery pick for survivors who need to repair health states during a match. It is safest when you can create enough space to finish the heal.
item.effect: Recovers two health states and takes 24 seconds for a full heal.

item.name: Adrenaline Shot
item.cardSummary: Adrenaline Shot is a clutch survival tool for short bursts of speed or a temporary downed-state pickup. It works best when the boost creates a real escape or rescue window.
item.effect: Gives a 7% speed boost for 10 seconds, then slowdown for 3 seconds. In the dying state, it picks the survivor back up for 12 seconds before returning them to dying state.

item.name: Motion Tracker
item.cardSummary: Motion Tracker is the cheap information item for survivors who want warning before the killer reaches an objective. It is strongest when you stop using it once the danger is already clear.
item.effect: Beeps faster and at a higher pitch when the killer is closer within a 250 radius.

item.name: WaxBound Candle
item.cardSummary: WaxBound Candle is the stronger information pick when you need a direct reveal instead of proximity sound. Its six uses make timing matter more than constant scanning.
item.effect: Reveals the killer's aura for 5 seconds, then goes on cooldown for 30 seconds. The candle has 6 uses.

item.name: Flashlight
item.cardSummary: Flashlight is the rescue tool for forcing a killer drop when they are carrying another survivor. It rewards good positioning more than raw price.
item.effect: Shining the flashlight on the killer can blind them and force them to drop a carried survivor. Full blind time is listed as 2 to 4 seconds depending on range.

item.name: Twist of Fate
item.cardSummary: Twist of Fate is a high-risk stun option for players who can accept a bad roll. A hit can buy distance or force a drop, but a misfire punishes the survivor instead.
item.effect: Aims and fires with a 60% chance to shoot and 40% chance to misfire. Hitting the killer stuns them for 2 seconds. A misfire costs the survivor one health state.

item.name: Parrying Dagger
item.cardSummary: Parrying Dagger is the timing-heavy counter tool. It can swing a chase when the parry lands, but a missed window leaves the survivor exposed.
item.effect: Gives a 0.8-second parry window. A successful parry stuns the killer for 4 seconds and puts the item on a 90-second cooldown. An unsuccessful use has a 60-second cooldown.

item.name: Riot Shield
item.cardSummary: Riot Shield is the most expensive item and a direct pressure tool. It can stun or force a carried survivor drop if the charge connects after enough ramp-up.
item.effect: Starts from walking speed and ramps to 18 studs per second over 4 seconds. The charge can last up to 35 seconds. Charging for at least 3 seconds lets the hit stun the killer.

item.name: Gate
item.cardSummary: Gate is an escape and rescue tool for creating sudden distance. It is risky near the killer because setup takes time and the teleport can also be used by the killer.
item.effect: Creates a one-way teleport point that lasts for 7 seconds and sends players to a random place on the map. Creating it takes 3 seconds and disables running. Interrupted use has a 5-second cooldown.

item.name: Shadow Clone
item.cardSummary: Shadow Clone is a misdirection item that can make the killer chase the wrong target or lose time near an objective. It is better when the killer has not already learned your plan.
item.effect: Conjures a smoke cloud and clone that runs forward in the direction the survivor is facing. The item has a 60-second cooldown after use or 5 seconds if interrupted.

item.name: Holy Water
item.cardSummary: Holy Water is the area-control item for slowing the killer around objectives, traffic routes, or strong looping spots. It is more about space control than direct escape.
item.effect: Throws an 8-stud radius area that slows the killer by up to 18%. The area lasts 10 seconds and the killer recovers speed after leaving it.
